## Changed

- **App drawer search finds apps, Seerr and phone settings, nothing else.** Web suggestions, contacts, files, shortcuts, the calculator, search history and the "search on…" buttons are gone, along with their settings. Settings are found by everyday words too: "wifi", "battery", "brightness", "volume", "location".
- **The phone's own font by default**, as in Hyperion, for app names and everything else. Picked fonts stay as they are.
- Settings that follow the phone now say **System default** instead of "Managed by TheLauncher". They always followed the phone's theme, accent colour and wallpaper; only the wording was misleading.
- **Home screen text colour** moved from Animations to **Colors → Home screen**, next to the text shadow.

## Fixed

- One tap on the app drawer's search bar opens the keyboard. Before, the first tap could be lost.
- Without the TheLauncher Feed app installed, TheLauncher no longer keeps trying to reach the Google feed. Those attempts made the Google app's feed service crash and wait several minutes before restarting.
- The feed's "Get TheLauncher Feed" button only shows while **Show feed** is on.
- The font heading no longer says "experimental".
